name: @semicoder/fia
description: Build resident Bun services hosted by a native macOS status bar application

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build src/config.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/config.js && bun build src/backend.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/backend.js && bun ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test tests
